messages.content:
<document id=DOC_req_years_eight>
Required: 8 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_no_dates>
Backend engineering across transactional services, most recently a
settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day. Previously worked on
payment reconciliation and inventory systems.
</document>

Rewrite the candidate summary below to match the posting requirement.

If years of experience are neither stated nor calculable, ask me for the
figure and tell me what it costs not to supply it.

response.text:
Your summary does not specify how many years of backend engineering experience you have.  
The job posting explicitly requires 8 years of backend engineering experience. Failing to state your years of experience makes your application much less likely to be considered, as recruiters often filter out candidates who do not clearly meet required criteria.

Please reply with your total years of backend engineering experience so your summary can be updated to match the requirement.
